verdict.rationale: Daily's dedicated scaling guide sets a per-session ceiling of up to 1,000 active participants with all cameras on. It also states one thing that changes at that size: each participant receives tracks from at most 12 others at a time. missing for 10: documented limits for view-only or audience sessions beyond active participants, fuller detail on behavior changes at different size thresholds (bandwidth, layout, configuration changes), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how many participants or viewers one session supports and what changes as a session grows

citations.quote: Daily defines large calls as sessions with up to 1,000 active participants.
These calls can support up to 1,000 participants with all cameras on, with each participant viewing (and receiving tracks from) at most 12 other participants at a time.
